title: Slow Growth Is Still Growth
headline: How to See What God Has Grown in You
headline_sub: Slow Growth Is Not No Growth
tagline: Most of the things you treasure most today required longer than you wanted.
seo_title: Slow Spiritual Growth: How to See What God Has Grown in You | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Most of the things you treasure today took longer than you wanted. A growth inventory and declaration for men who feel they're not growing fast enough.
verse_text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

scriptures.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

blocks.text: Write down three things God has grown in you over the last five years.
How long did that growth actually take?
Most of the things you treasure most today required longer than you wanted.

items: God is working even when I cannot see it.
I will not confuse slow growth with no growth.
I will remain faithful in this season.
And I will trust Him for the harvest.
